description: Held-out motion prompts for encoder/end-to-end parity. Not used to tune anything.
prompts: A person jumps over an obstacle and lands softly.
Someone dances energetically, spinning around twice with arms raised above their head.
A person picks up a box from the floor and places it on a shelf to the right.
A man performs a roundhouse kick, then returns to a fighting stance.
walking slowly with shuffled steps, then stopping to look around
A person sits down on a chair, crosses their legs, and waves hello.
A person runs in a circle counterclockwise.
